02 / WHAT IS GOOGLE ADS?

ADVERTISE
WHERE
INTENT LIVES.

Google Ads is a paid advertising platform where businesses can appear when people search for relevant products, services or solutions. Unlike broad awareness advertising, search campaigns can reach people at the moment they are actively looking.

The real work is not simply creating an ad. It is choosing the right searches, writing a relevant message, controlling spend, sending clicks to the right page and measuring what happens after the click.

01

Keyword Research

Find commercial and high-intent searches, group them logically and identify terms worth spending on.

02

Campaign Structure

Organise campaigns and ad groups around services, locations, products and search intent.

03

Search Ad Creation

Write relevant headlines and descriptions with clear offers, benefits and calls to action.

04

Conversion Tracking

Measure meaningful actions such as leads, calls, purchases, enquiries or bookings.

05

Optimisation

Review search terms, bids, budgets, ads and conversion signals to improve campaign efficiency.
